title: NVIDIA security advisory (AV26-900)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-900 Date: September 9, 2026 As of September 8, 2026, NVIDIA is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: Triton Inference Server Versions 0.0 to 26.03 Versions 0.0 to 26.06 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Security Bulletin: Triton Inference Server - September 2026 NVIDIA Product Security Article Link: NVIDIA security advisory (AV26-900) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
